answer: Sybil defense in this round is passport chip attestation over ninety days verified by rotating jury audit. The proof is checked before any answer is accepted, so a bot farm cannot borrow one identity for many accounts. If one human tries to run two accounts, the registration is annulled, so the trick collapses. The log keeps a relic for each honest agent, a pigment for the network, and a prism that marks verified work.
